visualReview.notes: Basilica of Santa Croce connected church exterior plus its separate integral campanile: long raised nave with tiled gable, repeated lower side-aisle gables, transept, rear chapels/polygonal apse, marble three-part western facade with rose and geometric green/pink inlay, three real recessed wooden portals and broad supported entrance treads, pinnacles and a tall pointed belfry/spire. Actual parent and32 integral mapped building parts control scale; the campanile has its own actual footprint. The separately mapped convent/cloisters, Pazzi Chapel, refectory and neighboring city buildings remain independent. No copied sculpture, frescoes, tombs, text or furnished interiors. Inspected 52 current frames. Three physically recessed wooden portals have closed floor/soffits under layered pointed hoods; broad supported entrance treads, large rose with nearby tracery, pale/green/pink geometric inlay and five silhouette pinnacles distinguish the front. Long nave, actual repeated side-aisle gables, transept/chapels and polygonal apse use separate tiled roofs. Campanile has its own full mapped base, actual open belfry with simplified pointed spandrels, clock abstraction and slender spire. Front projections were corrected to marble in the same continuous author/inspect/fix pass.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Seven roles share six existing 256px graphs: stone_limestone_weathered, stone_marble (trim/pink), stone_basalt, tile_ceramic, storefront and wood_plain. Canonical metric UVs, linear tints and baked graph means for skyline. Six textured draws/one skyline. No embedded images, private atlas or new graph. Separate POSITION/NORMAL streams and equal CPU/GPU geometry bytes. Each graph reads once; all model geometry disposed on unload. Flat review planes partly bury grade-specific foundations or treads and can reveal small cutout patches; retained native ground establishes fit.

mediumFiReview.notes: Four authored LODs 996 / 1536 / 2008 / 2556 triangles; initial skyline+district 218696 bytes, closeup 225600 bytes. Six GLBs zero Khronos errors/warnings; 309 actual mesh/contact probes; 45 actual PMTiles13/14/15 cases with34 detailed owned records. 52 current inspected frames. Skyline preserves complete nave/aisle/transept/apse/campanile and five front pinnacles with coarser three-tread approach; closeup adds nearby rose/portal/window mouldings, inlay/dentils and clock. Every LOD/failure/unload preserves2314 resident/2733 wider independent buildings, original201x201/6m terrain/roads and182931.513m² water. Failure retains all2348 resident originals; ground/water restored with zero live model geometry. Flat planes and synthetic neighboring blocks are style context, not fit evidence. Some lower side-aisle walls and campanile base are partly occluded by retained adjacent procedural buildings; source/whole-site views cover the envelope. Actual rear ground rises4.45m over front datum and buries some lower walls; exact rear floor/grade remains qualified. Default synthetic street/block/transition views and some shared details crop the long church or spire tip. Custom complete-LOD cameras, source turntables and full native views cover the whole envelope; those cropped frames assess local material/style only.
